other.general_negative.title: Recent update made app worse
other.general_negative.description: Customers say a recent update removed features and made the app frustrating or useless, and some are uninstalling it.
other.general_negative.note: Broad dissatisfaction with the update plus restrictions and general complaints without a single specific problem.

billing.other.title: Core features locked behind premium
billing.other.description: Customers report they cannot use basic features like song choice or playback without paying, and subscription purchase or sign-up problems block access.
billing.other.note: Mixes premium paywall complaints with subscription purchase and sign-up failures.

usability.ads.title: Too many unskippable ads
usability.ads.description: Customers say ads play very frequently, are long and cannot be skipped, interrupting listening and making the app unbearable.

playback.other.title: Songs will not play or cast
playback.other.description: Customers report selected songs fail to play, repeat or change, and playback through assistants or casting to other devices does not work.
playback.other.note: Mixes songs not playing with casting and voice assistant integration failures.

usability.other.title: Basic player controls removed
usability.other.description: Customers say skips are limited and repeat or replay options were removed after an update, leaving the music player less usable.
usability.other.note: Mixes removed skip and repeat controls with ad frustration and general complaints about lost features.

playback.connection_error.title: Wrongly reports no internet connection
playback.connection_error.description: Customers say the app shows a no internet connection message even when other apps and their network work normally.

playback.stops_or_pauses.title: Music stops or pauses randomly
playback.stops_or_pauses.description: Customers report playback cuts out or pauses on its own, sometimes mid-show, and the app may fail to load past the first screen.

usability.queue_playlist.title: Cannot choose specific songs to play
usability.queue_playlist.description: Customers say they cannot pick the song they want from a playlist or queue, and playlists are shuffled or replaced with other content.

catalog.other.title: Songs or content missing from catalog
catalog.other.description: Customers say expected songs are absent, the library feels empty, and some content like yearly summaries will not open.
catalog.other.note: Mixes missing songs with a Wrapped feature failing to open, unwanted recommendations, and a chart-policy complaint.

playback.crash_or_wont_open.title: App crashes or will not open
playback.crash_or_wont_open.description: Customers report the app crashes during playback, shows a black screen, or gets stuck on the loading screen after an update.

billing.charges_refunds.title: Feels like paying for basic features
billing.charges_refunds.description: Customers feel the app now charges for basic listening actions and that premium is pushed to earn money.

usability.ui_change.title: Dislike of new layout and changes
usability.ui_change.description: Customers dislike the redesigned layout and an update that changed shuffle, skip, lyrics and queue behavior.
usability.ui_change.note: Mixes layout dislike with lyrics and queue missing and shuffle and skip limits.

catalog.lyrics.title: Song lyrics fail to load
catalog.lyrics.description: Customers say lyrics do not load or show for some songs, including ones in their playlists, even after refreshing the app.

access.other.title: Cannot log in or access account
access.other.description: Customers say they cannot get into their account, see token errors, or lose offline listening after access problems.
access.other.note: Mixes login and token errors with ad complaints and internet connection messages.

access.login_failure.title: Login fails with connection error
access.login_failure.description: Customers cannot log in and the app says there is no internet connection, while other apps and their phone connectivity work.

playback.lag_or_skips.title: App is glitchy and laggy
playback.lag_or_skips.description: Customers describe the app as glitchy, barely working, and certain podcasts lagging, particularly for premium users.

billing.premium_only_feature.title: Skipping songs requires premium
billing.premium_only_feature.description: Customers say skipping or choosing specific songs requires premium, and subscription purchase shows a blank page.

downloads.offline_mode.title: Offline mode does not work
downloads.offline_mode.description: Customers say offline playback fails or is useless, and moving storage location can delete downloaded content.
downloads.offline_mode.note: Mixes offline mode failure with storage move deleting downloads.

downloads.other.title: Downloads stall in background
downloads.other.description: Customers say downloads get stuck in the background and only resume when they open Spotify, or fail to start at all.

catalog.missing_content.title: Some songs and features unavailable
catalog.missing_content.description: Customers say certain songs are unavailable and Canvas visuals disappeared after an update despite premium.
catalog.missing_content.note: Mixes missing songs with Canvas visuals no longer appearing.

catalog.recommendations.title: Unwanted song recommendations persist
catalog.recommendations.description: Customers say the app keeps recommending songs in their playlists even after turning recommendations off.

usability.navigation.title: Hard to navigate to chosen songs
usability.navigation.description: Customers say tapping a liked song opens the wrong track or a demo, and the new menu only offers shuffle.
usability.navigation.note: Mixes wrong-track navigation with the new menu offering only shuffle.

usability.podcast_ui.title: Podcast controls and formats changed
usability.podcast_ui.description: Customers say they cannot move between podcast episodes from the toolbar or switch between video and audio-only podcasts.
usability.podcast_ui.note: Mixes removed episode navigation with inability to switch video and audio podcast formats.

usability.shuffle.title: Cannot turn off shuffle for free
usability.shuffle.description: Customers say turning off shuffle requires premium and the old shuffle was replaced with worse song selection and no seeking.
usability.shuffle.note: Mixes shuffle turn-off premium requirement with removed seek and rewind controls.

access.account_hacked_or_lost.title: Account hacked and playlists lost
access.account_hacked_or_lost.description: A customer reports their account was hacked and playlists they had set up could not be recovered.

access.logged_out.title: Premium account logged out unexpectedly
access.logged_out.description: A customer reports their premium account was logged out automatically and phone number login then fails.

access.password_reset.title: Password not accepted
access.password_reset.description: A customer reports the app will not accept their password.

downloads.downloads_disappear.title: Downloaded music disappears
downloads.downloads_disappear.description: A customer reports previously downloaded content is gone when they go offline after a few months.

downloads.cannot_download.title: Cannot download music for free
downloads.cannot_download.description: A customer reports they cannot download music without a paid plan.

support.unhelpful.title: Support staff are rude
support.unhelpful.description: A customer describes the app's support staff as rude.
